children: Kroger Co reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $34.62B, net income of $642M and diluted EPS of $1.05, each up versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings including noncontrolling interests”. ³ Reported as “Net earnings attributable to The Kroger Co. per diluted common share”.
Revenue growth of 2.0% in the quarter (2.1% YTD) was driven by fuel and modest identical-store growth excluding fuel.
eCommerce sales increased about 14% (20% excluding disposals), led by Delivery solutions with improving profitability.
Category strength in natural foods, meat and seafood, bakery and pharmacy offset pressures from IRA drug impacts and egg deflation.
FIFO gross margin excluding fuel improved and OG&A benefited from cost savings and store productivity initiatives.
Announced acquisition of Giant Eagle for roughly $1.65B, expected to close in fiscal 2027 with limited divestitures for regulatory clearance.
